question: Build an SVM classification model to predict the binary outcome label using a 70/30 train-test split. Evaluate performance on both training and test sets and generate an ROC curve with AUC values for both sets.

expected_output.description: rows as classes and aggregate rows, columns should include Class, Precision, Recall, F1-Score, Support
FPR as x-axis, TPR as y-axis, training and test curves with AUC annotations
rows as train/test performance metrics, columns should include Metric, Value
